lines.en: Golden hair upright, I press forward step by step.

lines.zh: 气流把地上的灰卷成线
lines.en: My wake drags the ash into a line.
Stones I cross keep a crack.

lines.zh: 残影落在后面，人已经走远
lines.en: An afterimage trails; I am already ahead.
I do not run; I only walk faster.
Gold ki curls up past my shoulder.

lines.zh: 八字胡也压不住这股气
lines.en: Even my mustache cannot subdue this aura.
I walk the ridge line.
The ground gives way under me.
Boot down, dust up, the rhythm unchanged.
Transformed, my steps have grown lighter.
The golden aura settles slowly.
My hair stands, unmoved by the wind.

lines.zh: 我在试，这形态还剩多少
lines.en: I am testing what this form still has.
My shoulders drop; the ki eases.

lines.zh: 那小子现在到哪一步了
lines.en: How far has the boy gotten now?
I open my fist and look at it.
This power came too late.
My breath comes out hot.
I am not used to being this bright.

lines.zh: 空中浮着的碎石慢慢下落
lines.en: The floating gravel drifts back down.
My bones creak; I endure it.

lines.zh: 我在等一个能让我用全力的人
lines.en: I wait for someone worth my full strength.
My brow stays locked.

lines.zh: 头顶的光比太阳还刺眼
lines.en: The glow above me outshines the sun.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，金发在光里
lines.en: I look down at you through the gold light.
Your ki is barely worth noticing.
So you want to test me too.

lines.zh: 这个形态，是我自己挣来的
lines.en: This form I earned myself.
I do not hide power.
Stand back; the aura will scorch you.
You are trembling; I can see it.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是绿的，别搞错
lines.en: My eyes are green; do not forget it.
I need no sword; my hands suffice.

lines.zh: 你以为变身只是换颜色
lines.en: You think transforming only changes color?

lines.zh: 这副眼神，跟当年的卡卡罗特一样。
lines.en: That look is the same one Kakarot wore.
Three more seconds of that, and I move.

lines.zh: 这里没有一个够格的对手
lines.en: Not one worthy opponent here.

lines.zh: 你的气太杂，练得不扎实
lines.en: Your ki is muddy; your training is thin.

lines.zh: 我把手放到身前，示意放马过来
lines.en: I extend a hand: come on then.
The cape thrashes in my aura.
I need not ask your name.
My smile is cold.
I clench my teeth; my ki stutters.
This wound is not worth mentioning.
I wipe my mouth with the back of my hand.
My aura took most of it.
My aura nearly broke apart.
I press my side.
You landed that. Good.
I have not used everything.
In this form, I eat a lot.
Put it down; do not dawdle.
The aura burns my appetite wide open.
Not enough to fill me.
I am not picky, but there must be meat.
Transforming spends the body.
I swallow it in one go.
Do not bargain with food.
After eating comes training.
Keep half for yourself.
My aura throws you off.
Hitting me is like hitting a wall.
I waver, then hold.
That knocked my ki loose.
I put a hand out and stop you.
Your weight is nothing.
Once more, and I answer.
I gave half a step; count it a feat.
At my age, I let that go long ago.

lines.zh: 王族的血脉不需要解释
lines.en: Royal blood needs no explanation.
What I guard is my own pride.
Stand beside me and be quiet.
This power leaves me alone.
I press a hand to my chest.
I know a comrade from a spouse.
Let the past lie.
Let us simply settle who is stronger.
My aura stretches my shadow long.

lines.zh: 我连腰都不弯，用气托起
lines.en: I do not even bend; ki lifts it.
This thing is in the way.
I crush it in my fingers.
Interesting enough; I keep it.
I toss it to someone farther off.
What falls to the ground, I leave.
Dust clings to it; I wipe it off.

lines.zh: 这重量，我的气能举十件
lines.en: My ki could lift ten of these.
I glance, then throw it back.
It has no value.
You picked the worst day for this.
Big Bang Attack. Catch it.
I give you one chance first.
I raise my ki; the ground sinks an inch.

lines.zh: 这个形态不是给你看的
lines.en: This form is not for your viewing.
I have your ki locked.
Do not turn; turning ends it.
This open ground will do.

lines.zh: 你的每一步我都能预判
lines.en: I can read every step you take.
I need no charge-up.
Ki compresses into a sphere in my palm.
You will pay for this.
The gold light lights the whole area.
Get up; do not lie there.
I will remember this fight.
I let you move first.

lines.zh: 残影留在原地，人已到你身后
lines.en: An afterimage stays; I am behind you.
I flash to your flank.
Your ki is dropping.
I stay outside your sight.
Your legs are weakening.
This drains ki, but it is fast.
I move to your blind side.

lines.zh: 地面被我们的气推得开裂
lines.en: Our ki cracks the ground between us.
Do not try to find me with your eyes.
Your guard has one gap.
I hold ki behind my elbow.
One more pass and I close in.

lines.zh: 气弹已经排成一列对着你。
lines.en: My ki blasts are already lined up at you.
The Big Bang is still building.
The way you retreat is the way I left.
I am patient; I wait for you to fall.
My sweep is complete.
A charged rush, straight on.
Meteor combination, all the way through.
Aerial combo, pressing down from above.
One punch raises a shockwave.
A knee, then an elbow.

lines.zh: 你挡得住一下，挡不住三下
lines.en: You stop one; you cannot stop three.
Ki bursts at your chest.
I do not hold back on you.
My afterimage fooled your eyes.
The last blow slams into the ground.
I flip and land behind you.
That one was seven-tenths.
The shockwave rings the dust up.
Do not think I am winded.
My hand is still hot.
Second wave, incoming.

lines.zh: 金气一亮，我从空中落下
lines.en: Gold light flares; I descend.
Dust rolls twice as I land.
Hair upright, the glow remains.
This place is too small.

lines.zh: 我先确认这形态稳不稳
lines.en: First I check whether this form holds.
Ki spreads outward from my feet.
I raise a hand and press the glow down.
The surrounding gravel lifts.
No rival; a wasted transformation.
My cape stands straight in the aura.
My breathing is deep.
My ki pushes the clouds apart.
The soil underfoot is compacted by me.
I stand and wait for the glow to settle.
Back in this state again.

lines.zh: 我的影子被光照得发白
lines.en: The light bleaches my shadow.
Who is over there?

lines.zh: 这一身力量，用一次少一次
lines.en: This strength costs more each time.
Fire wraps around my arm.
I land too hard and my knee jolts.
Water dims the gold aura.
Something grazes my shoulder.
That force burrows into my bones.

lines.zh: 饿起来，变身都维持不住
lines.en: Hunger makes the form slip.
Lightning rides my aura through me.
Even the ki here is drained.
